meaning: to shout, cry out, call out

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese verb for crying out loudly or calling out to get someone's attention.

exampleSentences.english: Why do you shout so loudly?
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zou6 mat1 giu3 gam3 daai6 seng1 aa3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for calling out to attract attention, including calling or hailing a taxi; for a simple greeting, use 打招呼.

exampleSentences.english: I called out loudly to hail a taxi.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我喺路邊大聲叫，想截住架的士。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 lou6 bin1 daai6 seng1 giu3 soeng2 zit6 zyu6 gaa3 dik1 si2

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken verb for crying out or screaming when the exact cause is not important.

exampleSentences.english: I scream whenever I see that dog.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 go2 zek3 gau2 zau6 giu3

english.note: With a goose as the subject, this means making its characteristic honking sound rather than calling out to someone.

exampleSentences.english: That goose starts to honk whenever it sees a stranger.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰隻鵝一見到陌生人就叫。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 zek3 ngo4 jat1 gin3 dou2 mak6 saang1 jan4 zau6 giu3
